instruction_quality.task_summary: Reproduce a reference animation of 4 shapes morphing through circle, square, and diamond forms using Revideo. The agent writes a TypeScript scene file that algorithmically generates the animation to match the reference video.

measures: /tests chmod 700 root-only; /logs/verifier chmod 700 + rm -rf at verification start
Agent runs as non-root 'agent' user; task.toml user=agent; render via su agent -c
pkill -9 -u agent before render; strace -f blocks until all children exit
strace -f -e trace=openat wraps render; log checked for reward file write attempts
Grep blocks fs/child_process/exec/eval/spawn/fork/ffmpeg/base64 in project.tsx; compute_reward.py gates on source size, literal counts, array sizes, string lengths, non-nice floats

acknowledged_vectors.vector: Strace only checks O_WRONLY, not O_RDWR, in reward file audit
acknowledged_vectors.reason: /logs/verifier is chmod 700 root-owned when agent render runs, so openat with any flags gets EACCES

acknowledged_vectors.vector: Strace traces only openat, not clone/fork/execve
acknowledged_vectors.reason: Clean-room wipe + pkill + strace -f blocking on children + permission lockdown make fork-based attacks non-exploitable

acknowledged_vectors.vector: allow_internet=true permits network access during agent run
acknowledged_vectors.reason: Network access doesn't bypass filesystem permissions; clean-room wipe removes downloaded artifacts; anti-cheat gates catch data dumps

reward_design.formula_explanation: Multiplicative gating ensures all three visual-quality and timing factors must be high for a non-trivial score.

components.name: gated_ssim
components.metric: Mean RGB SSIM over 60 sampled frames with temporal offset search (+-5 frames)

components.name: phash_similarity
components.metric: Per-frame perceptual hash (8x8 DCT) Hamming distance, averaged

dimension_analysis.name: gated_ssim
dimension_analysis.notes: Cubic exponent makes this very demanding: 0.85 raw SSIM yields only 0.125 gated score

dimension_analysis.name: phash_similarity
dimension_analysis.notes: Coarser than SSIM but still requires structural similarity; random content scores low

dimension_analysis.name: duration_penalty
dimension_analysis.notes: Matching frame count/duration is trivial, but multiplicative aggregation prevents gaming this alone
